runs.text: Designer with six years of experience building brand identities, packaging and campaign systems for food, beauty and cultural clients. I care about bold ideas executed with craft — and about designing systems that teams can keep using long after launch.
Lead designer on identity and packaging projects for 20+ clients, including a rebrand that grew a snack client’s retail distribution from 300 to 1,100 stores.
Concepted and produced integrated campaigns across print, social and out-of-home. Built the agency’s first shared brand-guidelines template.
Designed exhibition graphics, wayfinding and event collateral for six major exhibitions.
Thesis: “Edible Type” — honourable mention, ADC Young Ones
• Oat & Ember — identity and packaging for a craft bakery chain
• City of Makers — campaign for the 2025 Brooklyn Design Week
• Kinfolk Tea — limited-edition tin series, sold out in 3 weeks
Figma, Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, After Effects, Procreate
• Type Directors Club, Certificate of Excellence, 2025
Risograph printing, community gardening, vintage type specimens
